current_study.direct_link_behavior: Requires PROLIFIC_PID, STUDY_ID and SESSION_ID plus a generated username/password assigned to the route. After validation: full consent and demographic flow, then the assigned task without the chooser. Sampling uses the credential's fixed assignment seed. The final screen is rendered only after the Worker verifies that D1 stored the complete response set and returns a receipt.

demographics.background_selection: Multiple selections, with none exclusive; exported as a JSON array
demographics.restoration_note: The removed fields, controls, CSV entries and validation remain commented in src/demographics.tsx.
demographics.validation: All questions required; text answers limited to 300 characters and cleared when hidden; skip available only for testing
demographics.privacy_notice: Information supports future study analysis; responses analysed and reported in aggregate without identifying individual participants; no promise of irreversible anonymization of raw records

current_study.persistence: localStorage checkpoint on trial advance plus authenticated submission through Cloudflare Worker to D1. D1 stores the credential-to-Prolific mapping, session/demographics/training/client and Cloudflare metadata, normalized trial rows and a payload receipt. A local CSV is available only as a testing or upload-failure backup.

response_backend.credential_storage: PBKDF2-SHA256 salted hashes only; plaintext distribution CSV remains private
response_backend.completion_rule: The UI enters the complete stage only after the API confirms completed status, response count and receipt_id in D1

test2_2afc.title: Reference matching
test2_2afc.sampling: Ten trials from each of four descriptor-derived levels: easy, medium_easy, medium_hard, and hard.
test2_2afc.question: Choose which of two options has the same underlying material as the reference.

training.assets: public/tutorial/t01_*.png and public/tutorial/t02_*.png; preloaded before Start test
training.progression: All three answers must be checked and correct in every example before beginning the study; answers reset between examples
training.feedback: Every incorrect identity, glossiness, or metallicness answer produces its own retry question and attribute-specific visual cue without revealing the correct answer; the information-button instruction is not repeated
training.logging: Every submitted combination is appended immediately to localStorage. The complete chronological attempt array is exported as JSON in pair_training_attempts_json on every pair-trial row. Training is excluded from experimental trial numbering and timing.

test1_pair_comparison.title: Pair comparison
test1_pair_comparison.sampling: Five pairs from each of eight strata; randomized order and A/B placement.
test1_pair_comparison.question: Three independent required answers for every pair: material identity (1 probably different, 3 unsure, 5 probably same), which surface appears more glossy, and which appears more metallic. Appearance comparisons are always visible and exported, including for probably same.

test3_matching.title: In-context matching

training.materials: G90/G91/G92/G94 low gloss and low metallic
conditions: bumpiness_1 to ridges_0 with fixed illumination

test3_matching.question: Match one labelled material across two rows of four objects.

test4_mm.title: Multiple matching
test4_mm.sampling: Three SVBRDF references and seventeen measured references by default. Every setup contains same/easy, same/hard, different/easy, and different/hard candidates. The source bank retains its existing balance of 2, 3, 4, and 5 true matches among eighteen candidates. Setup sampling is unchanged; the UI temporarily displays six shuffled candidates in a 2 x 3 grid, with one or two intended matches, and allows up to two selections. The CSV records only the displayed candidate order.
test4_mm.question: Select every candidate with the same material as the reference.
